messages:
Maria G.: Quick heads-up: ran a 1k-sample mini-bakeoff for faultline-7b across fp16 / int8 / int6. Sharing raw numbers + odd regressions.
Ryan K.: nice - drop perf + rough unit-costs?
Maria G.: paste from the run:
```
model | p95_ms | rps | est $ / 1k tokens
faultline-7b fp16 | 150 | 120 | 0.12
faultline-7b int8  | 160 | 110 | 0.08
faultline-7b int6  | 170 | 105 | 0.06
```
Sophie L.: quality deltas? quick numbers/examples.
Maria G.: eval on 200-sample open_qa subset: fp16 EM=0.72, int8 EM=0.70, int6 EM=0.62. int6 drop concentrated on multi-hop and long-context (>=200 tokens).
David P.: any hallucination / safety regressions?
Maria G.: two clear hallucination cases on int6 where it invented a citation. Example: prompt 'Summarize the main findings of the paper on adaptive caching.' fp16: correct summary + real cite. int6: plausible summary that fabricates a paper/title/link.
Ryan K.: how did you compute $/1k tokens?
Maria G.: est_cost = (GPU_hourly / tokens_per_hour) * 1000. Assumptions: GPU price $2.4/hr, measured tokens/s steady-state: fp16=33k, int8=50k, int6=66k. +10% network/overhead.
Sophie L.: int6 saves ~50% vs fp16 but drops ~14pt EM on multi-hop - risky for product.
David P.: could route by prompt features? short/simple -> int6, complex -> fp16. we have an L0 difficulty classifier.
Maria G.: ran a quick sim on 10k production-like prompts: routing 70% to int6 and 30% to fp16 gives blended cost ~$0.07/1k and blended EM ~0.69 (baseline 0.72) - acceptable for some non-critical endpoints.
Ryan K.: any latency tail when falling back int6->fp16?
Maria G.: fp16 fallback adds ~200ms sync; p99: int6 slightly higher due to CPU fallbacks on some nodes.
Sophie L.: recommendation for GTN/product: default int8 not int6. int8 is small quality loss (0.02 EM) with decent savings.
David P.: propose default int8 with flags: route_on <=120 tokens -> int8; >120 -> fp16; enable predictive difficulty classifier as 5% canary.
Maria G.: action items: 1) run full 10k slice sim with product prompts; 2) expand regression tests for hallucination signatures on int6; 3) small rollout plan: canary 1% -> 10% -> 50%.
Ryan K.: add rollout plan to the canary doc once you have results.
Sophie L.: +1 on regression tests and add a tiny human-review set for multi-hop.
David P.: @Maria G. can help wire the classifier and run the slice tomorrow.
Maria G.: thanks - will ping when dataset is pushed to bench infra.
eval-bot: smoke test: mini-bench artifacts uploaded to /bench/runs/3111112222 (checksums OK) :white_check_mark:
Sophie L.: :thumbsup:
Ryan K.: good start - this is actionable for product. keep us posted on the 10k sim.
